fiction.title: HOLLYWOOD, ENDING
fiction.author: John Green
fiction.description: Celebrity permeates lives onscreen and off for two rising stars appearing in the biopic “Andy Warhol Never Gets Old.”

fiction.title: SOMETIMES I SCARE MYSELF
fiction.author: Jeneva Rose
fiction.description: Three horror stories: “Never Kill the Medium,” “The Nightmare House” and “All Curses Are Final.”

fiction.title: HOLLOW BONES
fiction.author: Jodi Picoult
fiction.description: A woman who runs the Rhode Island Department for Emergency Preparedness and her husband, who is a police polygraph expert, face a crisis in their marriage.

fiction.title: THE CALAMITY CLUB
fiction.author: Kathryn Stockett
fiction.description: As things get tougher during the Depression, several women look for ways to improve their circumstances.

fiction.author: Lucy Foley
fiction.description: At a secluded hotel in the Swiss Alps during a blizzard, Miss Marple must determine the identity of a killer.

nonfiction.title: SWAN SONG

nonfiction.description: The ninth Earl Spencer shares personal stories about his sister, Diana, from childhood through her untimely death.

nonfiction.title: ROLL THE CALLS

nonfiction.description: The Hollywood mogul charts his rise to power and depicts behind-the-scenes stories about the entertainment industry.

nonfiction.title: ACTUALLY, NEVERMIND
nonfiction.author: Taylor Tomlinson
nonfiction.description: In a collection of essays, the comedian reflects upon her life as she approaches the same age her mother was when she died.

nonfiction.title: AN UNEXPECTED LIFE
nonfiction.author: Gloria Steinem
nonfiction.description: A memoir by the recently deceased feminist journalist and icon in which she recounts her six decades of activism.

nonfiction.title: THE PERILOUS FIGHT
nonfiction.author: Colin Kaepernick with Nick Chiles
nonfiction.description: The Super Bowl quarterback and civil rights activist describes defining moments in his life and their outcomes.
